title: Shared world art grammar for readable survival environments

palette.outline: one pixel dark shared outline; no black sticker borders

supply_cache.read: worked iron + cloth latch + plank body; state changes are art-only until A3 binds reward authority

ordinary_harvestable.read: natural material, repeated clusters, no container latch and no shelter roof
ordinary_harvestable.glow: only exceptional mineral may use reserved soul accent

major_waystation.read: large open awning + counter + warm lamp + maintained court + banner; visually larger than any container
major_waystation.collision: visual overlay only; canonical stands and bodies remain authoritative

background_scenery.read: lower contrast, smaller silhouettes, no latch / lamp / counter

physical_danger.read: broken stone + rust warning cap + impassable mass beside the route; no arbitrary red border

restricted_access.read: ruin mass and warning cairn communicate old closure; never a fake interactable gate

return_route.read: maintained road, repeated warm markers and shelter silhouette leading back to the postern

authored_landmark.read: canonical POI silhouette with worked material and local culture; not a new POI and not a loot container
authored_landmark.collision: visual overlay only; canonical POI anchor/obstacle remains authoritative

ashen_crown.transition: ash -> moor -> soil; road wear and court gravel mark maintained ground

amberwood.transition: grass -> forest floor -> bog/moor; orchard rows and herb clusters mark tended ground

frost_crown.transition: snow -> tundra -> basalt; wind-packed snow edges and exposed ore mark the cold frontier

overcast_frontier.notes: neutral grey-violet daylight; warm shelter pockets at night

amber_morning.notes: living green/amber canopy; warm worked windows

frost_blue_hour.notes: cold snow/basalt; soul-cyan shrine accent and rare warm refuge

production_rules: A1 presentation is a visual overlay. It never changes walk, collision, stands, instance ids, cache ids, rewards, saves or A8 interaction state.
All sprites are unscaled atlas frames on the 16 px grid. No per-site palette swaps and no non-integer scaling.
Use OverworldOcclusion.configure_sprites for tall vegetation / architecture so the Hero remains readable.
Lighting uses only A1-owned CanvasItemMaterials / Light2D nodes in isolated presentation; AVFX original Gold and A0 production lighting remain untouched.
A0 alone mounts production scenes. A8 keeps local interaction art/engine; this grammar is a conformance target, not a takeover.
Macro-terrain boundaries are authored causal landforms (geology/drainage/terrace/court/exposure), not random noise. Tile variant hash only selects texture inside an already-authored material.
A1 world lights use a private CanvasItem cull mask; inherited Gold/Hero VFX remain on the default mask and are never ambient-tinted by A1.
